answer: Think of reputation as a glacier: it moves slowly, carves deep, and cannot be faked overnight. Build the economy as a terrace of trust levels — newcomers transact only in small, low-value tiers and climb as their work is countersigned over time. A fresh identity starts at its nadir, with zero standing, and every sybil clone must redo years of glacial accumulation before it can touch high-value deals, making mass fakery cost more than it earns.
